crossRefs.note: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!
But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.
It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled…

translations.web: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”
translations.bsb: So how can you comfort me with empty words? For your answers remain full of falsehood.”
translations.kjv: How then comfort ye me in vain, seeing in your answers there remaineth falsehood?
translations.asv: How then comfort ye me in vain, Seeing in your answers there remaineth only falsehood?
